cases.expected: Real App A discovers/downloads/installs B automatically when safe; authenticated readiness, commit and exact identity confirmed.
Successful update preserves saved minimized startup preference.
No Cancel or Discard choice exists; direct cancel/discard requests cannot stop a required download.
Required install needs no confirmation and waits automatically while Panic, edits or visible protected windows make restart unsafe.
A complete valid save drains before update preparation; B preserves settings.
Explicitly discard pending edits; update uses the saved baseline only.
Pending edits keep A protected without a dialog or silent discard/save; normal edit resolution allows automatic continuation.
Invalid numeric/grid input prevents update; edits remain visible.
Global Panic blocks apply until normal PIN unlock; update is never an unlock route.
A locked profile blocks apply even without a running protected window.
Wrong synthetic PIN never reveals content or permits apply; never record the PIN.
Build policy fixes Stable/Preview and ignores old channel preferences; older/equal or incompatible versions are never installed.
Old saved opt-out cannot disable required checks; startup/reconnect/daily and bounded failure retries honor durable server deadlines.
Network failure does not replace A or turn an incomplete result into up-to-date.
Known Retry-After survives channel switch and process restart, including pre-apply checks.
Altered metadata/archive/payload is rejected before App exit.
Fresh apply checks reject a removed or changed release before App exit.
Preflight and actual write failure preserve baseline/recovery; no partial success claim.
Temporary locks are handled truthfully; no unsafe overwrite, deletion or false cleanup success.
Ordinary Exit cancels and drains pre-acceptance cleanup without granting consent or self-deadlock.
Isolated VM crash/restart restores or commits according to durable recovery evidence.
A durable commit is not reverted solely because its final receipt was lost.
Separately authorized disposable-machine fault test; VM process-kill is not physical power-loss proof.
Real scaling, monitor movement, keyboard and focus preserve usable Update now/Cancel/Discard actions.
